title: Customer eBGP session stays Idle — remote-as misconfigured on R2
symptom: Customer eBGP session R2 -> R3 (192.0.2.2) does not reach Established; prefix count stays 0; CustA has no connectivity.

inject.note: Real peer is in AS 65010; this sets the wrong remote-as so OPEN never agrees.

ground_truth.root_cause: remote-as mismatch on R2 toward R3 (configured wrong, peer is 65010)
ground_truth.fix: router bgp 65001 / no neighbor 192.0.2.2 remote-as 65999 / neighbor 192.0.2.2 remote-as 65010
ground_truth.verify: show bgp summary shows 192.0.2.2 Established with prefix count > 0
